answer_1.quote: This paper proposes a simple yet effective IMT approach, BiTIIMT, which addresses the issues above. The core idea to BiTIIMT is the Bilingual Text-infilling (BiTI) task which extends textinfilling from monolingual setting to bilingual setting and aims to fill missing segments in a revised translation for a given source sentence.
answer_1.outputs: translations with filled missing segments based on human-edited partial translations and source sentences

answer_2.quote: We employ BLEU to measure translation quality, and human editing cost to measure efficiency, which is calculated as the edit distance by counting deletions on word level and insertions on char level.

answer_4.quote: we randomly sample 200 sentences from the Zh-En test set and then ask two professional human translators to interact with both systems. Translators are asked to do interactions (deletions, revisions, and insertions) multiple times until they get a satisfactory translation.
